notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing the 3 stage demo of [i][b]Bionic Tadpole[/b][/i] during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. 
Until further updates, the demo will remain available to download, but with only one playable stage.
